value.message: These settings allow you to customize the controller name, description and the preferred default values for controller input properties.
Edit the name and description of the controller.
Edit the default input values for controller input values using URL params or GlideRecord queries.
This should be used for dynamic defaults, static defaults can be set in Editor mode after adding properties.
